fixture_description: Synthetic challenge authored before this slice was run. Fictional sources and relevance labels were authored together by an AI agent; no independent human review. Prior experiments on a separate fixture were known, so this is an additional exploratory slice, not a sealed benchmark or unbiased holdout. Relevance is source-level rather than chunk-span-level.
method: Exact dot-product of L2-normalized embeddings; no query prefix, matching source embed_texts; single full document per source; all 31 ranked; no reranking or generation. Ties broken by source id.
